response.sql: WITH observatory_shares AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM observatory_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.telescope_count), 0) AS combined_telescopes, AVG(o.share) AS average_share, AVG(o.share - a.share) AS average_excess_share FROM observatory_shares AS o CROSS JOIN overall_average AS a WHERE o.share > a.share;
